_meta.source: TNB Domestic ToU (TNB calculator-domesticTOU.js v1.1.65) + JomCharge app Aug 2026. The 2023 EV residential block (home_ev_special RM0.25) no longer exists; home EV charging is billed under the standard Domestic ToU tariff.
notes: home_ev_marginal_rm_per_kwh is the MARGINAL cost of adding EV charging to a baseline 400 kWh/month household under Domestic ToU (10% peak / 90% off-peak overnight charging), validated in scripts/used_market/compute_charging_cost.py. Representative 150 kWh/month EV draw -> RM74.79 marginal bill delta.
AFA is the automatic fuel adjustment surcharge from TNB rates.js FUEL_BY_MONTH; only applies above 600 kWh/month total usage.
Public rates are JomCharge app prices (AC RM1.10 / DC RM1.40), blended 50/50 -> RM1.25.

tnb_tariffs.home_ev_marginal_note: Marginal ToU cost (baseline 400 kWh household + 150 kWh/mo EV draw, 90% off-peak/10% peak, incl. capacity, network, incentive tier shift; AFA 2026-08 +0.038 excluded as draw straddles the 600 kWh threshold)

public_charging_rm_per_kwh.note: JomCharge app Aug 2026 (AC RM1.10 / DC RM1.40), blended 50/50 for the station share

ev_road_tax.note: EVs RM2 road tax via Finance Minister incentive; phase-in announced in RM #5 2026: 10% of ICE-equivalent rate from 2026.
